card.name: Digits inside years and dates
card.fires_on: Individual digits partway through a year, such as the 0 in 2000 or the 9 in 1912, mostly in citations and titles. Sometimes a month or period word after a date-like phrase.

modes.label: Digits in years
modes.description: A middle or final digit of a four-digit or two-digit year in references and names.

modes.label: Time words in titles
modes.description: A month or week word in a publication or feature reference.
